CS processing

API for processing collected CS records.

get https://apiweb.shoplinker.co.kr/ShoplinkerApi/Cs/Cs_action.php?iteminfo_url=XML_URL[URL-encoded]

Request Parameters

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. Required customer_id string Customer code (Shoplinker registration code) Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. Required cs_id string CS code Set this to the cs_id collected by Shoplinker. e.g. 00692813
3. Required mall_id string Shoplinker marketplace code * Enter this code accurately. If the marketplace is not listed, add it in the marketplace setup.
ex) APISHOP_0001
4. Required mall_user_id string Marketplace account ex) Auction login ID -a123
5. Required cs_contents string Reply content

XML sample

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr"?>
<Shoplinker>
	<cs_info>
		<customer_id>고객사코드</customer_id>
		<cs_id>00692813</cs_id>
		<cs_contents>20110709</cs_contents>
		<mall_id>20110711</mall_id>
		<mall_user_id><![CDATA[shoplinker]]></mall_user_id>
	</cs_info>
</Shoplinker>

Response

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. result bool Result flag Allowed values
  1. - Success : true
  2. - Failure : false
2. cs_id string Shoplinker CS code
ex) 00692813
3. message string Result message Success or failure message 
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="EUC-KR"?>
<Shoplinker>
	<ResultMessage>
		<result> true</result>
		<cs_id> 00123456</cs_id>
		<message><![CDATA[cs처리성공]]></message>
            </ResultMessage>
</Shoplinker>
